app.title: Sketch Village
app.subtitle: Defend the village you drew yourselves
app.update_ready: A new version of the game is ready.
app.offline_ready: The game now works without internet too.

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.hint: Put the paper on the table, well lit and fully visible.
camera.error_unsupported: This browser can't use the camera.
camera.error_denied: Camera is blocked. Allow it in the browser.

bg.title: Remove the paper
bg.hint: Use the slider to choose how much paper disappears. Checkerboard = transparent.
bg.inside: Also erase paper inside the drawing

editor.name: Name
editor.author: Drawn by
editor.levels_hint: Each upgrade level has its own drawing. A missing level uses the previous drawing.
editor.slots_hint: Only the first drawing is needed. Draw the hero holding a sword, bow or magic wand too – the game shows it with that weapon.
editor.need_name_image: Name or first drawing is missing

catHint.hero: The main character. Give it skill points.
catHint.enemy: Monsters that attack from the caves.
catHint.townhall: Town hall in the village centre – 3 levels.
catHint.decoration: Trees, rocks, flowers for the map.
catHint.coin: Coins dropped by enemies. Each coin drawing has its own value.
catHint.building: Every kind of building: pick what it does (workers, arrows, soldiers, coins, healing) and its levels – or draw another look for an existing kind. The town hall is one of them.
catHint.weapon: Swords, bows, magic wands. Every drawn weapon is playable: set its kind, one or two hands and damage next to the drawing.
catHint.shield: Shields for the left hand – set how much damage they absorb.
catHint.armor: Armor for the body – set how much damage it absorbs.
catHint.chest: Treasure chest dropped by enemies – it holds a weapon.
catHint.texture: Photos or drawings of surfaces – grass, stones, sand, a carpet… In the map editor (Terrain) a colour of the map can be covered with them.

import.error_not_json: This is not a game data file.
import.error_wrong_format: This is not a Sketch Village file.
import.error_newer_version: The file is from a newer version of the game.
import.error_generic: The file could not be loaded.
import.done_review: Done: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{kept}} kept as yours, {{unchanged}} already the same.
import.review_counts: {{added}} new things will be added. {{changes}} things you already have are different in the file – check them:

data.title: Save & load
data.export_hint: One file with everything: all drawings with their animations and numbers, enemies with legends, buildings, maps with waves and terrain, themes, rules and settings. Take it to another computer.
data.import_hint: New things from the file are added. Things you already have (found by name) that are different in the file are shown with what changed, and you decide: update or keep yours. Nothing is deleted.
data.purge_hint: Download everything first, just in case.
data.confirm_purge_all: Really delete ALL drawings and maps? This can't be undone.
data.pack_hint: Drawings, maps and rules the teacher put on the website. Adds them to yours – nothing is deleted.
data.pack_none: The website has no class pack yet.
data.pack_teacher: For teachers: how to share with every computer
data.pack_howto: Download everything (button above), rename the file to default-data.json and replace public/default-data.json in the game's GitHub repository. After the website updates, every new computer starts with it, and others can press “Load class pack”.

maps.title: Maps
maps.empty: No maps yet. Paint a new one or start from the sample.
maps.name: Map name
maps.no_decorations: Draw some decorations in the Drawing studio first.
maps.decor_on_road: Decorations go on the grass, not on the road.
maps.hint_road: Yellow road – you can walk on it. Lead roads from the map edge to the centre.
maps.hint_grass: Green grass – nobody can walk on it. Works as an eraser for roads.
maps.hint_pencil: Draw decorations. Careful: a line across a road blocks it.
maps.hint_fill: Fill an area with one colour.
maps.hint_place_centre: Click where the town hall stands. It must be next to a road.
maps.hint_place_spot: Click next to a road – buildings will go here. Place as many as you like.
maps.hint_place_cave: Click next to a road – anywhere on the map. The cave sits right beside the road, so its enemies know where to go.
maps.cave_need_road: A cave must be next to a road – click closer to one.
maps.hint_place_decoration: Pick a picture (trees, mountains…) and click on the green grass. Drag to move.
maps.hint_place_erase: Click the thing you want to remove.
maps.valid: The map is ready to play!
maps.problem_no_paths: There is no yellow road on the map.
maps.problem_centre_off_path: The town hall must be next to a road.
maps.problem_spot_far: Spot {{n}} is too far from a road.
maps.problem_cave_too_close: Cave {{n}} is too close to the town hall.
maps.problem_cave_off_path: Cave {{n}} is not next to a road.
maps.problem_cave_not_connected: No road leads from cave {{n}} to the town hall.
maps.problem_respawn_off_path: The hero start must be next to a road.
maps.terrain_hint: Every colour of the map can look like a texture in the game – grass, stones, water… You still paint with colours here, so the bucket fills correctly.
maps.share: Share this map (a file with the map and the drawings it uses)

play.title: Play
play.no_maps: No map is ready. Create one under Maps.
play.no_heroes: No heroes – you'll play with a stick figure. Draw a hero in the Drawing studio.

game.hint: Click a road = walk · click an enemy = attack · drag = move view · wheel = zoom · 1/2/3 = sword/bow/magic · space = Ready
game.wobble: Pencil wobble – drawings move a little
game.lost_hero: The hero has no lives left!
game.ready_hint: Start the wave now – every second saved earns coins
game.msg_cant_hit: Flying enemies can only be hit with the bow (2)!
game.msg_hero_down: The hero fell! Back at the town hall in {{s}} s. Lives left: {{n}}
game.turn_phone: Turn the phone sideways to play.

build.ruin: Destroyed – build it again (from level 1) or clear the ruins.
build.th_sub: More health ({{hp}}) and buildings and hero can reach level {{n}}
build.th_heals: heals the hero standing next to it

component.look_hint: Only pictures – the game picks one of the looks at random for every building of that kind.
component.core_hint: The town hall stands in the village centre from the start. Its level limits all other levels; when it falls, the game is lost.
component.levels_hint: One picture per level. The town hall level must be at least as high.
component.confirm_restore: Put back the default name and numbers? Pictures stay.
component.picture_hint: Without a picture the game draws a simple shape.

feature.hint_workers: Workers make all building and upgrading faster.
feature.hint_shoots: Shoots the enemy in range that is closest to the town hall.
feature.hint_soldiers: Keeps soldiers that patrol the road around it and fight walking enemies there – never further than the patrol distance; then they go back to their place.
feature.hint_income: Gives coins after every survived round.
feature.hint_healHero: Heals the hero standing close to it.
feature.line_healHero: heals the hero +{{heal}}/s up to {{healRange}} away
feature.hint_lobs: Throws a stone at the biggest group of walking enemies – it hurts all of them where it lands. It can’t hit flying enemies or enemies right next to it.
feature.line_lobs: stone {{lobDamage}} on area {{lobSplash}}, range {{lobRange}}, every {{lobCooldown}} s

weapons.title: Weapons
weapons.hint: Weapons add to the hero's attack. Sword-like ones hit up close, bows shoot, magic hurts everything around the target – even flying enemies. The hero finds them in chests from enemies or buys them in the town hall shop.
weapons.confirm_reset: Reset all weapons to the default ones?
weapons.empty: Nothing yet. Enemies sometimes drop a chest 🎁, and the town hall has a shop.
weapons.need_magic: Magic needs a magic weapon – find one in a chest or buy it at the town hall.
weapons.need_melee: You have no weapon for close combat.
weapons.reason_none: You have no weapon of this kind yet.
weapons.reason_switching: Wait – the hero is still changing weapons.
weapons.reason_twohand: Both hands hold a two-handed weapon.
weapons.reason_wrong_slot: That doesn't fit there – weapons go in the right hand, shields in the left, armor on the body.
weapons.drag_hint: Drag a thing onto a hand or the body – or tap it, then tap the slot. Drag it back into the backpack to take it off.
weapons.bag_empty: Everything you have is on the hero.
weapons.starter: hero has it from the start
weapons.studio_hint: Weapons, shields and armor you draw in the Drawing studio are items too – their numbers are set there, next to the drawing.

enemies.title: Enemies
enemies.hint: Pick a drawing from the studio for each enemy and set its numbers. Changes apply to all maps.
enemies.confirm_reset: Reset all enemies to the default values? Your new enemies will be removed.
enemies.name: Name
enemies.color: Colour (used until there is a drawing)
enemies.confirm_delete: Delete enemy “{{name}}”? Waves that use it will skip it.
enemies.minions_hint: Pick which enemies it calls – each time one of them at random. Minions never call minions themselves.

waves.title: Waves – {{map}}
waves.confirm_reset: Replace all rounds with the default 20 rounds?

tips.walk: Click the yellow road – your hero walks there.
tips.build: Click a dashed square next to the road to build. Start with a tower – it shoots arrows!
tips.ready: Ready? Press ⚑ Ready to call the wave early – you get bonus coins.
tips.fight: Click an enemy to attack it. ⚔️ sword is strong, 🏹 bow shoots from far away.
tips.coins: Enemies drop coins. Walk over them before they vanish!
tips.townhall: Click the town hall: upgrade it and make your hero stronger.
tips.bow: Flying enemies can only be hit with the bow – press 🏹 or key 2.

rules.title: Game rules
rules.hint: Rules for the whole game. Buildings, enemies, weapons and coins have their numbers next to their pictures in the Studio. Saved in the data file with everything else.
rules.confirm_reset: Reset all rules to the default values?
rules.townhall_hint: The town hall level limits how far buildings and the hero can be upgraded.
rules.hero_costs_hint: Bought at the town hall. Level N needs town hall level N.
rules.components_note: When buildings become available is set on each building level in the Studio.
rules.unlocks_hint: Something new after every wave. Round 1 = available from the start. The town hall level and coins still apply.
rules.hero_hint: Each hero spreads the skill points in the Drawing studio. Every Town Hall upgrade adds one more point to that stat.
rules.waves_note: Starting coins and prep times apply to maps without their own waves (waves are set per map).
rules.g_balance_heroHealRadius: Healing reach around the town hall
rules.g_balance_chestCoins: Coins from a chest when you have every weapon
rules.g_build_interactRadius: How close the hero must stand

themes.title: Themes
themes.hint: Worlds like plains, graveyard or goblin forest. Enemies and buildings can belong to themes, and every map can have one: on a map only buildings of its theme (or without a theme) can be built, and the wave editor shows the theme’s enemies first.
themes.confirm_delete: Delete the theme “{{name}}”? Things and maps that use it stay, only without this theme.
themes.label: Themes
themes.component_hint: Which worlds it belongs to. None ticked = it fits every world.

anim.title: Animation
anim.hint: An animation is a row of pictures (frames) side by side, played one after another. Make each frame here like any picture – draw it (the previous frame shows faded underneath, to trace over), take a photo, upload or paste it. Tip: copy a frame (⧉) and change it a little. You can also open a photo of a whole strip of 4–12 frames – it is cut into frames. Then drag each frame over the previous one to line them up. Without an animation the still picture is used.
anim.align: Line up – frame over the previous one
anim.frame_copy: Copy this frame (then change the copy a little)
anim.frame_copy_last_hint: A new frame as a copy of the last one – then change it a little
anim.panels_hint: {{n}} of {{max}} frames · click a frame to line it up below

chronicle.title: Chronicle
chronicle.intro: All monsters of the land with their stories and hints. Write your own legends in the studio (Enemies).
chronicle.legend_hint: A short story about this monster and a hint for the player. They are in the chronicle (📖) and pop up when the monster comes for the first time.
chronicle.story_placeholder: Where does it live? What does it like?
chronicle.no_story: No story yet – write one in the studio!

shop.title: Town hall shop
shop.go_to_hall: The hero must stand at the town hall to buy – tap the town hall to walk there.

safety.title: Backup & keeping drawings safe
safety.unsaved_zero: today’s changes are not in a backup
safety.unsaved_one: changes from {{count}} day ago are not in a backup
safety.unsaved_other: changes from {{count}} days ago are not in a backup
safety.persisted: The browser promised to keep your drawings.
safety.best_effort: The browser may delete the drawings when space runs low or the game isn’t opened for a long time. Download backups – or install the game.
safety.unsupported: This browser can’t promise to keep the drawings. Download backups often.
safety.ask_keep: Ask the browser to keep them
safety.install_why: Install the game: it opens from its own icon, fills the whole screen and plays without internet.
safety.installed: The game is installed – it plays without internet too.
safety.install_ios: On iPhone or iPad: in Safari tap Share ⬆ and then “Add to Home Screen”. Only then does Safari keep the drawings for good.
safety.install_menu: In the browser’s menu choose “Install app” or “Add to home screen”.
safety.reminder_one: Your drawings from {{count}} day ago are only in this browser. Download a backup so they can’t get lost.
safety.reminder_other: Your drawings from {{count}} days ago are only in this browser. Download a backup so they can’t get lost.
safety.refused: The browser said no for now. It usually agrees once the game is installed or played more often – until then, download backups.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.easy_hint: weaker, slower monsters, more coins, 2 extra lives
difficulty.normal_hint: as the numbers in the studio say

maptest.title: Let the robot try
maptest.hint: a robot plays this map with these waves 3 times, like a careful player
maptest.verdict_too_hard: Too hard – the robot never won.
maptest.verdict_hard: Hard – the robot won only sometimes.
maptest.verdict_ok: About right – won, but not without trouble.
maptest.verdict_easy: Maybe too easy – won every time without losing anything.

paste.button: Paste a picture from the clipboard
paste.title: Paste a picture
paste.how: Copy a picture (a screenshot, or right-click → Copy image), then press Ctrl+V (⌘V on a Mac). On a phone or tablet: long-press the box and choose Paste.
paste.empty: There is no picture in the clipboard – copy one first.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.hint: Record the monster’s voice (up to 3 s) or load a sound file. The game plays them now and then – not on every step – so they stay special.
sounds.no_mic: The microphone isn’t available – allow it in the browser, or load a sound file.
sounds.cant_play: This browser can’t play this sound.
sounds.too_big: The file is too big – use a short sound (under 600 kB).
sounds.preview: Hear it as in the game
sounds.preview_hint: a little wave of this monster, the way the game plays the sounds
sounds.preview_skipped: left out – too soon after another sound
sounds.preview_why: {{monsters}} monsters came. The game leaves out sounds that come too close together, so even a big wave doesn’t turn into noise – and each recording stays special.
